description: Source file implementing lazy tensor native functions for PyTorch, including tensor creation, copying, and various operations with lazy tensor support.

methods.name: CreateLtcTensor
methods.description: Creates a lazy tensor wrapper around a given tensor and device.

methods.name: GetLtcDevice
methods.description: Retrieves the backend device from an optional device, only if of type lazy.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Returns a clone of the tensor, special in lazy tensor context as a no-op.

methods.name: _copy_from
methods.description: Copies data from one tensor to another, handling lazy and eager tensors.

methods.name: _copy_from_and_resize
methods.description: Copies data from one tensor to another and resizes the destination.

methods.name: _to_copy
methods.description: Converts tensors between eager and lazy, supporting device and dtype conversions.

methods.name: empty_symint
methods.description: Creates an empty tensor with symbolic size, supports lazy tensor creation.

methods.name: empty_strided_symint
methods.description: Creates a strided empty tensor with symbolic size.

methods.name: fill_
methods.description: Fills a tensor with a scalar value, supporting lazy tensor.

methods.name: max_pool3d
methods.description: Performs 3D max pooling with autograd support.

methods.name: max_pool3d_with_indices
methods.description: Performs max pooling with indices, calling fallback due to custom autograd.

methods.name: max_pool3d_with_indices_backward
methods.description: Backward pass for max pool with indices, calls fallback.

methods.name: _unsafe_view
methods.description: Returns a view of the tensor with specified size.

methods.name: lift
methods.description: Lifts a tensor into a functional tensor wrapper for functionalization.

methods.name: lift_fresh
methods.description: Lifts a tensor into a functional tensor wrapper, similar to lift.

methods.name: block_diag
methods.description: Creates block diagonal tensor, functionalized for lazy tensors.

methods.name: new_empty_strided_symint
methods.description: Creates a new empty strided tensor with symbolic size.

methods.name: narrow_copy_symint
methods.description: Performs a narrow copy operation with symbolic size.

methods.name: pixel_shuffle
methods.description: Performs pixel shuffle operation, functionalized.

methods.name: pixel_unshuffle
methods.description: Performs pixel unshuffle operation, functionalized.

methods.name: select_backward_symint
methods.description: Backward operation for select with symbolic size.

methods.name: _trilinear
methods.description: Performs trilinear operation, functionalized.

methods.name: linalg_pinv
methods.description: Computes pseudo-inverse, functionalized.

methods.name: svd
methods.description: Performs singular value decomposition, functionalized.

methods.name: logsumexp_out
methods.description: Computes logsumexp with output, handling functional tensors.

methods.name: diag_embed
methods.description: Creates diagonal embedding, functionalized.

methods.name: diagonal_backward_symint
methods.description: Backward operation for diagonal with symbolic size.

methods.name: slice_backward_symint
methods.description: Backward operation for slice with symbolic size.

methods.name: native_group_norm
methods.description: Performs group normalization, reusing core implementation.
